routeReview.assessment: The mean/variance and causal lower-bound arguments are absent in print; the two gap nodes are genuine missing explanations, not assertions that library solutions cannot exist.

Source Eq1.1/1.2 and admissibility motivate both nonnegativity claims. SG-CAUSAL remains unresolved by the printed paragraph. Mean/benchmark expansion is separately recorded in SG-RISK and derived R-MIN/R-CROSS.
Tracks the criterion/equivalence only. No route proving every strategy successful is present; positive normalization and the asymptotic bridge stay outside these targets.
Requires every-history representation and coherent choice of one family; no nu-dependent witness permitted.
Snoc induction must preserve old coordinates, not confuse action history with uniform history.
All three conclusions are required; pointwise finite-prefix equality is stronger than an almost-sure dependence assertion.
For history at t, previous generated actions use uniforms with indices <t; full outcome stream is independent of tape. History measurability is additionally used in L-JOINT.
Fresh uniform integration plus h-kappa and measure extensionality suffice conceptually; no IID/bounded outcomes needed.
One sufficient route: joint factorization and uniqueness of disintegration under the generated-history marginal.
Alternative sufficient route: tests on history events and a countable determining class on I. Not an AND prerequisite of D-JOINT.
Fresh uniform independence alone is insufficient for independence from Y_t when nu is dependent. This route correctly also requires lifted IID and strict-past causality.
Integrability and common mean are needed to kill the centered cross term.
Requires expected fixed comparator minimization, not exchange of infimum and expectation.
All conjuncts use one f selected before all nu and T. Conditional law needs one of the two OR routes; all non-risk clauses are independent of IID/support hypotheses.

sourceDeltaLedger.detail: All five endpoints are derived infrastructure/application contracts. Neither page prints kernel, uniform representation, recursive sampler or conditional-distribution theorems.
Past-known/current-outcome-hidden information is made exact as dependence on u_0,...,u_t and y_0,...,y_(t-1). Current private uniform is permitted; future uniforms are excluded pointwise.
Action-inclusive finite histories and arbitrary real outcome prefixes are new model choices. Sampler realization applies to all histories, including unreachable histories.

The product law U×nu covers exogenous outcome streams, including dependent/unbounded streams for law clauses. It does not model the full printed p3 action-reactive adversary or prove equivalence to every hidden-state/causal policy model.
Fresh-seed independence, standard-Borel representation and conditional-law disintegration/uniqueness are external derived obligations, not omitted printed theorems or public assumptions of T5.
T5 risk branch retains IID independent coordinates, common marginal and [0,1] outcomes. Support is stated coordinatewise almost surely; countability yields simultaneous support for a fixed nu.
Expected fixed benchmark is inf over c in [0,1] of expected cumulative loss; equality to T variance requires a derived feasibility/optimality bridge. It is not expected empirical hindsight regret.

Zero-based t and every natural horizon T, including zero, extend the positive-round source convention. Eq1.2 division interpretation uses positive T only; no normalized/little-o conclusion is asserted.

No convergence or sublinear-success theorem, executable sampler, uniqueness of the sampler, arbitrary action-space representation, stopping-time theorem, completed-filtration equivalence, chapter/book closure or original-PR disposition follows.
